body:
## Scope and classification

Add rendering for the existing DrawingML `chord` preset in Spreadsheet, including its two angular adjustments. This is an enhancement to a currently unsupported shape: the existing intentional placeholder preserves its XML. It is not a claim that engine Save deletes the shape, and does not include SXC converter control loss or small converted width differences.

Related: format acceptance #30 and worksheet object overview #75. Integration exclusively assigned this bounded follow-up outside the current release intake.

## Independently reproduced environment and source

Ordinary Windows suite2026.48.1, source `dc3f8d5d6e8fdffaaec82caa4ab93b579e075e6b`, tree `5a644e397ecc6af5452a49b6404edf953687d1b2`. Native run45164747391 and independent bundled-converter control45166523239; retained proof commit `d74ff7a8fa29a1109b2a0f6b8290615a0899a3f2` on `codex/sxc-native-windows-2026-11-23`.

Genuine LibreOffice/core@92c170f11d44857d8e365f2e29fb449dfb567ff5 `sc/qa/unoapi/testdocuments/calcshapes.sxc`,13030bytes, SHA256 `9a367d8e849001453b7d5684401f769abd63a621165ea3878da9d64b6fe2de2d`. Its unchanged actual converted XLSX has SHA256 `7b3410fa3b5cb0897bf6a4caf61390e65199aa5e9f5c1f95f3025c49932c1196`.

## Reproduction and observations

1. Open the real SXC through the native picker and bundled converter, or open the retained actual converted XLSX through the supported browser XLSX route.
2. Inspect the shape anchored at C3. Its `a:prstGeom prst="chord"` contains `adj1=7798761`, `adj2=347606`; extent958320×736560EMU.
3. The native screenshots show a preserved-object placeholder at that location, rather than the cut ellipse.
4. The source reader classifies only six basic presets as renderable; `chord` is currently unknown. The SVG and print-canvas renderers do not draw it.
5. Save, fully close and reopen. All object-related XLSX parts remain byte-identical to independent converter output: the drawing is retained, but its shape preview remains unsupported.

No new native fixed-build result is claimed. Existing warnings about form controls and unrelated geometry differences remain separate.

## Expected behavior and acceptance criteria

- Render the actual chord arc and closing straight edge from the preset's angular adjustments in the worksheet SVG layer and existing print canvas.
- Keep original preset, adjustments, styling, rotation/flips, anchors, grouping and unknown OOXML. Do not replace the source with an image, rectangle or flattened document.
- Test major/minor arcs, wrap across zero, equal-angle/full-turn and invalid/degenerate inputs; use independent ellipse/ray intersection expectations, not screenshots of a placeholder.
- Use the real converted source to verify visible curved geometry, normal edit/UndoRedo/save/fresh reopen and independently unchanged object XML.
- Record browser and Windows/Linux/macOS results at one corrected code point; explicitly retain missing native package checks. No extra native/Mac build or current critical release intake is authorized by this follow-up.

## Duplicate check

Open and closed chord/ellipse/DrawingML searches and descriptions of #30, closed#43 and open#75 were read. No matching bounded chord-rendering issue was found. #75 remains the existing overview; no new overview is created.

## Implementation and scoped validation — 23 November 2026

Implemented on `codex/sxc-chord-render-2026-11-23`, handoff commit [3df5ec0314c8af95da4bc35324baa55a136e0b85](https://github.com/OpenAEC-Foundation/open-office-studio/commit/3df5ec0314c8af95da4bc35324baa55a136e0b85). The product implementation is commit `cbaebf81c7e5926d545fd77ca8f4b83703304854`; later changes only prepare/verify this test and retain evidence.

Fixed/tested source `42d161a3d494fb56fa159501a510a34ac95f6fd0`, tree `436d8f94c68b8fb5d9b6b23c6dd8485502f1bfd6`. Windows static TypeScript and25 focused tests pass on that same source. [Linux CI45171202941](https://github.com/OpenAEC-Foundation/open-office-studio/actions/runs/45171202941) passes those25 tests, actual browser source/edit/UndoRedo/SaveAs/download/fresh-context reopen on `/` and `/office/`, and four production print-canvas component cases. The156880 sampled non-boundary pixels have zero mismatches against the independent conic/chord oracle; minor-case interior coverage is245 points. Six actual saved XLSX are independently checked for original cell/annotation context, new marker/formula/cache42 and byte-identical original object parts.

Proof artifact14817341148, full ZIP SHA256 `8598a2e4bf252395f86c8d6e6a4317a4a65161dc0805fc0e3998ca051137af55`. [README and retained evidence](https://github.com/OpenAEC-Foundation/open-office-studio/blob/3df5ec0314c8af95da4bc35324baa55a136e0b85/qa/sxc-chord-render/README.md); repeat `python -B qa/sxc-chord-render/audit_bundle.py`. It binds official ZIP/run/job/source identities, Windows source checks and independently parsed saved XML. Original setup/pixel-coverage driver failures remain archived; criteria were not reduced.

This issue remains **open for integration and corrected native Windows/Linux/macOS package checks** on a future candidate. Integration explicitly prohibited extra native/Mac builds and excluded this follow-up from the current critical intake. The browser proof uses the existing Vite development route and actual converted XLSX; it does not claim direct browser SXC conversion, optimized hosted-build or complete native print/PDF acceptance. Own CI browser/contexts/server are closed; no local GUI/recording was started.

Radio/TextBox conversion loss and small width differences remain separate deferred findings. Existing control warnings remain. A broken/alt GIF preview visible in the Linux screenshots has no established load/baseline cause in this chord scope; its original bytes are unchanged and it is not reported as a general image appearance pass or a newly diagnosed defect.
title: Spreadsheet: render existing DrawingML chord shapes instead of placeholders
